## 🛡️ Scams & safety alerts
- **Digital arrest scam steals ₹33.4 lakh in Hyderabad:** A retired LIC employee lost ₹33.4 lakh after receiving a video call from scammers impersonating Karnataka police officers who claimed his bank account was linked to money laundering [[Hyderabad Mail]](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMinAFBVV95cUxNTVJPTmptYVU2QUF4bUJEMzREWWhqd0lGb3dUSWh2alBIMDIxek13UXVoME51ckdmTmhSUmtmUUtVR3BqZmx6YXVsbFFHdEhsMzhWa0w0NE42d3BEZlNTY2NhczZmWEtWcFlESEJmbEh1Z21qcEs2UzJQMVU0ZGxxMkZmdVRjdlM2WUppV21RM29mSHF3X2xRTXpvVEU?oc=5) [[News Mobile]](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMitgFBVV95cUxQQy1zNXRybmJ2ZG1mSmJiSHJjUjJkZXcwVVpyR1BQU290RkVPTUFiUTQ3Zm1PYkJxb0ZKUHRiVkNMczNfa3dCRFlvdG5zMTRwTldPNGl6bzQ0akdBWGVTUldmYXVORE5rS183QXhfenJRdWpDQnFoU0hNQWZzLWxZNkZvSjM5RXpCaU5GYWQyUjU0bHNxUU1QSW9ZQ0luTG95N2dQZWVGQ1VpLUpPdkNVbXZPZVB3dw?oc=5).  
  *What to do:* Police and law enforcement agencies never conduct "digital arrests," demand money, or inspect bank accounts via video calls. If you receive such a call, hang up immediately and dial 1930 [[Hyderabad Mail]](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMinAFBVV95cUxNTVJPTmptYVU2QUF4bUJEMzREWWhqd0lGb3dUSWh2alBIMDIxek13UXVoME51ckdmTmhSUmtmUUtVR3BqZmx6YXVsbFFHdEhsMzhWa0w0NE42d3BEZlNTY2NhczZmWEtWcFlESEJmbEh1Z21qcEs2UzJQMVU0ZGxxMkZmdVRjdlM2WUppV21RM29mSHF3X2xRTXpvVEU?oc=5).
- **FTC takes action against Shein over shipping claims:** The US Federal Trade Commission (FTC) moved to penalize retailer Shein $100 million over deceptive delivery promises and customer service issues [[Whittier Daily News]](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiuwFBVV95cUxNUXlUNWtnTE5NV3pKTGZXM0k1S0dvaXpZS0RFZE1GMFd0cExtUzUtc1BHdk9sNlVCOUhaRWk2MGN5RFFfUERVQ0FiMGxvYTdjTDR0X2xNeDJzRlg0aTBUbHdjRDdOM3JwLUdBOXg4c2ZNdmZHN0pMQUIwUFd3R2ZLRTd1eTJOLUFCZmpPT3JINkZEWmUwcnc5SjZ6OGx2em9ZalNaa2RnVFFPM1plNzJXNk84WG9EVVJjVDdR?oc=5) [[South China Morning Post]](https://news.google.?oc=5).  
  *What to do:* Keep receipts and original order confirmations when shopping online, and file dispute claims directly with credit card providers if delivery deadlines are breached [[Yahoo]](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMif0FVX3lxTE44VVZNc1BwdDdLeW5ld1QwZ0tncVJrMGdrV1liUU1mTFFLa29HekRpekhINDhUazlkRW03ZmlPXzhhTmxMOHpLam9GSWpqZHc5bzNXbVl0UWdLZ2k4RmlfWmJoVlhOWmdyanMwLUpQRDVTYmI1eGJFX2d2bFJJMms?oc=5).
- **Fake FTC phone deactivation calls:** Scammers calling US numbers claim to be FTC representatives threatening immediate mobile line deactivation unless personal details are verified [[FOX6 News Milwaukee]](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMid0FVX3lxTE1QclhtNmxZUlp6cng0S1pVYlFZQ212Z2NLLXZadVlrZ3l3N2pGMmNUbXVjb3lkUXNrSlVrTWdnckw1SU1DSUVkUjJfb181Q0RWRUNDNndncHpzXzBPUklHTmhvVXZwZzN0M2RacGd2U2p0dExhVkZF?oc=5).

## 🔮 Future signal
- **Gravitational data transmission through solid barriers:** Physicists successfully encoded and transmitted digital messages through a solid brick wall using moving mass counterweights and ultra-sensitive gravity sensors [[ScienceDaily]](https://www.sciencedaily.com/releases/2026/11/261123005343.htm). While radio waves and light signals are easily blocked by dense metal or earth, gravity cannot be shielded by any known material. Within 5 to 10 years, refined gravitational communication systems could enable un-hackable, un-jammable communications for deep underground facilities, submarines, and bunker networks where traditional radio signals fail.

## 🎓 Today's lesson
- **Grey Market Premium (GMP):** The Grey Market Premium is an unofficial, unregulated cash price at which an upcoming IPO share is traded informally before its official stock exchange listing. Because grey market trading takes place entirely outside SEBI or SEC regulatory oversight, GMP values are easily manipulated by operators to generate artificial retail enthusiasm. Investors should focus on audited financial statements, debt levels, and business model fundamentals in the official prospectus rather than relying on unofficial grey market quotes.
